conditions: Cave-dwelling loach, new species. Measured specimen: holotype WGY2024121901, 47.3 mm TL, 38.8 mm SL, collected 19 December 2024 in a karst cave near Duoru Village, Dukang Town, Tiandeng County, Guangxi, China (545 m); sex not reported for any type specimen (no sexual dimorphism observed, per the paper). Paratypes WGY2024121902-WGY2024121905 (43.6-55.3 mm TL, 33.9-47.1 mm SL), same cave. Table 2 caption: 'Morphological characters and measurement data (mm) of the new species Balitora tiandengensis sp. nov. and B. anlongensis (data from Luo et al. 2023) and B. ludongensis (data from Liu et al. 2012b).' Table 2's second header row prints 'WGY2024121901 (holotype)' over the first data column, and that column's Standard length cell is 38.8, equal to the holotype SL in the type-material text. The quote row also holds the other four paratype columns (0.9 1.1 0.9 1.2), the mean 1 +/- 0.2 and two comparison-species values (B. anlongensis holotype 1.3; B. ludongensis holotype 1.9); only the holotype is filed (the header row's paratype labels sit irregularly, so paratype columns are not filed here). Description sentence: 'Eyes small, 12.7-17.1% HL.' (holotype head length 7.0 mm: 1.1/7.0 = 15.7%, inside that range).
